purpose: Test whether selecting a proxy on the target audit and then reusing that audit inflates false validation.
candidate_construction: Every candidate has one Bernoulli requirement at tolerance plus invalid_gap; its other requirements have safe_risk.
selection_rule: Choose the candidate with the smallest exact intersection-union p-value on the screening target.
comparisons: Test the selected candidate without correction on the same target records.
Test the selected candidate without correction on a fresh independent target audit.
Apply Holm to the complete screened family on the original target records.
primary_endpoint: Probability of validating at least one invalid candidate.
